subject: MedNex MAP: deployment-mode reconciliation & region constraints
messages:

Subject: MAP draft + question on deployment mode (hosted / dedicated / private)

Alex — attaching the first-pass Mutual Action Plan for the POC (see MedNex_MAP_v1.pdf). Two quick asks before we finalize timelines: 1) can you confirm whether MedNex has a hard requirement to run in a private VPC/on‑prem for regulated PHI flows, or is a US-hosted Redwood instance with dedicated capacity sufficient? 2) Are there any KMS/HSM constraints we should model into the deployment notes?

On timing: our proposed MAP shows a 6-week evaluation if you select Hosted or Dedicated; Private adds ~3–4 weeks for infra + validation. If you prefer, we can map out a split-path plan with a hosted canary and a private cutover window.

Next steps I propose: you confirm the deployment preference and procurement constraints, we lock the acceptance criteria for the eval sprint, and Lauren will scope the SLO/cost tradeoffs.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + question on deployment mode (hosted / dedicated / private)

Jonas — thanks for the MAP. High level: MedNex wants customer PHI to remain within our VPC for the pilot. We are open to a dual-path evaluation: start with Redwood Hosted in a US region for feature/latency validation but we need an agreed plan and timeline to migrate to Private (VPC) for PHI flows before pilot go‑live. Procurement notes: our security team requires KMS integration (Cloud KMS or HSM) and SOC2 evidence.

Can you update the MAP to show a split-path and an explicit migration gate (we call it Gate 2) before pilot go‑live? Priya from Security and Procurement is cc'd.

—Alex
Alex Zhao
Director, Platform Engineering | MedNex Health
alex.zhao@mednex.com

Alex — got it, thanks for the clarity. We've updated the MAP to include a split-path approach and explicit Gate 2 (migration to Private VPC for PHI) in the attached revised doc. Quick notes from our side: 
- Hosted -> Dedicated: short friction (mostly config + capacity sizing) — estimate 2 weeks to validate throughput at your SLA.
- Hosted/Dedicated -> Private: requires VPC peering or customer-hosted connector, KMS integration, and audit validation — estimate 3–5 weeks depending on networking change windows.

Lauren — can you add acceptance criteria for the Gate 2 migration (latency delta tolerance, KV cache warm-up checklist, and security artifact handoffs)? Karthik — can you confirm whether our Private package will allow MedNex to bring its own KMS (BYOK) or if we need to propose our KMS-integration path?

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachment: MedNex_MAP_v2.pdf (MAP v2, split-path + migration gate)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@mednex.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + question on deployment mode (hosted / dedicated / private)

Looping in a short technical summary for Priya/MedNex security: 
- BYOK/KMS: We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS or external HSM). For Private (VPC/on‑prem) we can mount HSM endpoints; for Hosted we offer KMS integration with envelope encryption.
- Data residency: Hosted runs in a US region (us-west-2 or us-east-1). Dedicated gives isolated capacity in those regions. Private enables on‑prem/VPC-only egress controls.
- Timeline: If MedNex opts for immediate Private for PHI, estimate 3–5 weeks for network + key exchange + SOC artifact handoffs. If you start hosted for feature testing and then cutover, allocate a 2–3 week migration window in the MAP to cover cutover dry‑run + acceptance.

I can prepare a short checklist (network firewall rules, CIDR allowlist, KMS ACLs, handshake certs) and attach it to the MAP.

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: security-summary-2026.xlsx (checklist stub)

From: Priya Anand <priya.anand@mednex.com>

Thanks for the clear notes. A couple of requirements from MedNex Security:
1) We need documented proof of SOC2 in the MAP supporting Hosted/Dedicated for non-PHI.
2) For Private, we need a timeline showing when key rotation and audit logs will be available after cutover.
3) Procurement: if migration to Private is in the MAP, we expect a firm cost delta and any one‑time infra fees to be surfaced in the commercial terms.

Can you update the MAP to include: an explicit SOC2 page (or link to attestation), a migration acceptance checklist, and a high‑level cost delta estimate for Private vs Dedicated. We need the updated MAP and redlines by EOD next Wednesday to stay on our procurement deadline.

—Priya
Director, Security & Compliance | MedNex Health

Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 14:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + question on deployment mode (hosted / dedicated / private)

Priya/Alex — thanks for the checklist. Attached are the items you requested: redwood_sla_draft_redlines.docx with proposed language on migration, a short SOC2 summary page and the cost delta estimate (Hosted: baseline; Dedicated: +12% capacity premium; Private: +38% one‑time setup + +20% ongoing).

Plan recap we committed to in MAP v3:
- Week 0–2: Hosted canary (no PHI) — feature validation + perf baseline.
- Gate 1: Acceptance on feature & perf (signed off by MedNex Eng).
- Week 3–5: Private prep (networking, KMS, certs).
- Gate 2: Dry‑run migration + security artifact handoff (signed off by MedNex Sec & Redwood).
- Week 6: Pilot go‑live with PHI flows in Private.

If that timeline works, Jonas will update the MAP doc and we can route the SLA redlines and order form to Procurement for signature. Please confirm by EOD Thursday so Procurement has time to finish vendor review.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
